title: Tenric task (v0.1.0, proposed)
description: One piece of work to be delivered under one contract version. Written by the contract owner, never by the backend. A task names what to do; the contract says what an acceptable deliverable is.

id.description: Becomes the experiment_id of the artifact.

data_class.description: measured unless the task is a demonstration fixture. A fixture task must say so in its title.

brief.description: What to investigate, in prose. Required by agent backends.

script_producer.description: Repository-relative directory holding a pre-written producer (experiment.py, config.json, claims.json). Required by the script backend.
